content:
From \((b-1)(c-1)=1\), we have
\[
b=1+\frac1{c-1},\qquad c>1.
\]
Then
\[
b+4c=1+\frac1{c-1}+4c.
\]
Minimize:
\[
\frac{d}{dc}\left(1+\frac1{c-1}+4c\right)=-\frac1{(c-1)^2}+4=0
\]
so
\[
(c-1)^2=\frac14,\qquad c=\frac32.
\]
Then
\[
b=1+\frac1{1/2}=3.
\]
Thus
\[
b+4c=3+4\cdot \frac32=9.
\]
\[
\boxed{9}
\]
